events.evidence: Iran's navy says that an oil tanker caught on fire after hitting a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz
The Houthis fire missiles at King Abdullah Financial District in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, which damage the Public Investment Fund Tower and other buildings but cause no injuries
Anthropic holds its initial public offering, raising roughly US$81 billion and becoming the largest IPO in history by amount raised

label.note: Middle East escalation threatens Gulf assets and Hormuz shipping, while record Anthropic IPO supports risk appetite.
